products.name: Linian Superclips CC6 Fire Rated Cable Fixing, 12mm - 14mm, 44kg, Black, Steel [Pack of 25]
description: The LINIAN SuperClip™ is an innovative, single-component fire-rated fixing supplied by Ocunio, engineered to replace traditional cleats, conduit saddles, and nail-in clips for faster, neater, and fully compliant EV charging installations. Perfected for high-efficiency commercial and domestic applications, it provides secure, professional anchoring for steel wire armoured (SWA) cables, EV Ultra combined cabling, bunched conductors, and conduit runs. Designed to streamline site work and significantly lower labour times, the fixing requires no wall plugs, screws, or washers—installers simply drill a hole, slip the clip over the cable, and push it directly into place for an immediate, robust hold.

Built to exceed modern electrical safety standards, the SuperClip™ is fully compliant with BS 7671:2018+A2:2022 (18th Edition) regulations to prevent the premature collapse of cables in escape routes. It delivers unmatched thermal resilience with a melting point exceeding >1200°C, backed by independently verified 90 and 120-minute fire resistance testing to British and European standards, as well as strict smoke emission testing compliant with London Underground criteria. Reusable and easily removed when required without substrate damage, it offers an extraordinary upgrade in safety, durability, and on-site efficiency.

Engineered for universal site flexibility, the SuperClip™ anchors reliably into virtually any substrate, including brick, masonry, concrete, stone, timber, plasterboard, and light, heavy, or hollow blocks. By combining high tensile strength with an effortless, plug-free push-in installation, it ensures electrical contractors deliver safer, simpler, and tidier containment across every EV chargepoint project.
